question.:question/worked-solution:
To solve this integral, we use the by-parts formula, given by

$$
\int u{v}^{′}\,\text{d}x=uv-\int v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x.
$$

We need to express $\int 10 x\operatorname{sin}(x)\,\text{d}x$ as $\int u{v}^{′}\,\text{d}x.$ Therefore, we set

$$
\begin{aligned}u=10 x\, & ⟹\,{u}^{′}=10 \\ {v}^{′}=\operatorname{sin}(x)\, & ⟹\,v=-\operatorname{cos}(x).\end{aligned}
$$

We substitute the above into the integration by parts formula, and we get

$$
\begin{gathered}\int u{v}^{′}\,\text{d}x=uv-\int v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x \\ \int 10 x\cdot \operatorname{sin}(x)\,\text{d}x= \\ 10 x\cdot (-\operatorname{cos}(x))-\int (-\operatorname{cos}(x))\cdot 10\,\text{d}x.\end{gathered}
$$

Finally, we calculate the integral, as follows:

$$
\begin{gathered}\int 10 x\operatorname{sin}(x)\,\text{d}x= \\ -10 x\operatorname{cos}(x)+10\int \operatorname{cos}(x)\,\text{d}x \\ =-10 x\operatorname{cos}(x)+10\operatorname{sin}(x)+C\end{gathered}
$$

$$
\int u{v}^{′}\,\text{d}x=uv-\int v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x.
$$

We need to express $\int 10 x\operatorname{csc}^{2}(x - 8)\,\text{d}x$ as $\int u{v}^{′}\,\text{d}x.$ Therefore we set

$$
\begin{aligned}u=10 x\, & ⟹\,{u}^{′}=10 \\ {v}^{′}=\operatorname{csc}^{2}(x - 8)\, & ⟹\,v=-\operatorname{cot}(x - 8).\end{aligned}
$$

We substitute the above into the integration by parts formula, and we get

$$
\begin{gathered}\int u{v}^{′}\,\text{d}x=uv-\int v{u}^{′}\,\text{d}x \\ \int 10 x\cdot \operatorname{csc}^{2}(x - 8)\,\text{d}x= \\ 10 x\cdot (-\operatorname{cot}(x - 8))-\int (-\operatorname{cot}(x - 8))\cdot 10\,\text{d}x \\ =-10 x\operatorname{cot}(x - 8)+10\int \frac{\operatorname{cos}(x - 8)}{\operatorname{sin}(x - 8)}\,\text{d}x.\end{gathered}
$$

Finally, we calculate the integral using the substitution $u=\operatorname{sin}(x - 8),$ where $\text{d}u=\operatorname{cos}(x - 8)\,\text{d}x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{gathered}\int 10 x\operatorname{csc}^{2}(x - 8)\,\text{d}x= \\ -10 x\operatorname{cot}(x - 8)+10\int \frac{\operatorname{cos}(x - 8)}{\operatorname{sin}(x - 8)}\,\text{d}x \\ =-10 x\operatorname{cot}(x - 8)+10\int \frac{1}{u}\,\text{d}u \\ =-10 x\operatorname{cot}(x - 8)+10\ln|u|+C \\ =-10 x\operatorname{cot}(x - 8)+10\ln|\operatorname{sin}(x - 8)|+C\end{gathered}
$$
